checklist.question: Can retirement savings be improved?
checklist.reason: Every wage earner contributes at least half of the 401(k) limit
checklist.rule: a 401(k) contribution under 50% of the $23,500 limit flags retirement for review (under 15% is high priority)

checklist.question: Can tax savings be made?
checklist.reason: No self-employment income, early distribution or under-withheld distribution
checklist.rule: self-employment income above $0, a 1099-R code 1 early distribution (estimated 10% additional tax), or a code 7 distribution with federal withholding under 10% of the taxable amount flags tax for review

checklist.question: Is there excess cash to put to work?
checklist.reason: Cash covers 3.0 months of income, within 6 months
checklist.rule: cash above 6 months of income (AGI / 12) flags excess cash for review (above 12 months is high priority)

checklist.question: Is more documentation needed?
checklist.reason: No conflicts, missing proof or mismatched values
checklist.rule: documents that disagree, an HSA contribution with no documented eligible plan, or a value its document contradicts means more documentation is needed

checklist.question: Anything major changed since last year?
checklist.rule: with a prior year on file, a new dependent, a new employer, a new mortgage, or AGI changing 25% or more is a major change (3 or more together is high priority)
